create_game_adapter: create a subclass of BaseGameEnvAdapter to implement a new game environment adapter for LLM consumption
update_game_state: update the game state by deserializing a pyspiel observation and extracting legal actions and current player
convert_action_to_string: convert a native action integer to its string representation using the OpenSpielGameAdapter action_to_string method
convert_string_to_action: convert an LLM action response string into a valid native action integer using string_to_action
get_readable_state: get a formatted string representation of the current game state suitable for LLM consumption
